description: Mechanism assay on the THETA-SCREEN-V13 residual: declare the pre-committed fixed rings (cabin-mate ring, same-table dining party) as the first spend against each shedder's per-epoch exposure-cap budget, so the pooled droplet/HVAC cohort draws only the remainder. Motivation is measured, not speculative: ROUTE-ATTR-V1 read ~98% of infected dose weight ring-side (near-field plume 60-69%, cabin-mate addback 30-40%, pooled far-field ~2%) and THETA-SCREEN-V13 measured the clause outcome cap-invariant -- the EXPO-CAP-01 budget gates only the pooled routes while the fixed rings deliver unattenuated dose outside it. Under RING-CAP-V1 (transmission.exposure_cap.include_fixed_rings: true) a shedder's unavoidable ring contacts displace incidental pooled reach inside the same Poisson budget; rings themselves still dose. The assay replays the v13 stage-2 cell family verbatim at the measured admissible band plus the Theta 1e9 anchor: per (theta, arm) the takeoff-conditioned recorded_onsets and before_share vectors answer whether ring-first budgeting moves the clause outcome class at any admissible Theta. This is an assay, not a re-admission: no Theta is selected on this design, and a clause-class change is followed by a re-screen design, not an adoption.
prerequisites: THETA-SCREEN-V13 measured (edb7fc41): admissible band {1.78e11..5.62e11} under capped reach; conditional clause FAILS at every admissible Theta -- takeoff-seed q05 floors 1,770-2,024 recorded onsets vs the record's 197, before_share medians 0.81-0.94 vs 0.173; PASS only at the Theta 1e9 boundary anchor.
ROUTE-ATTR-V1 measured: ~98% of infected dose weight ring-side; the pooled far-field routes the cap bounds carry ~2%.
EXPO-CAP-01 internals verified: the per-epoch budget bounds only _droplet_unit_doses and _apply_hvac_downstream_doses; the cabin-mate addback, near-field unit and table deals bypass it entirely.

RING-CAP-V1 flag ships default-off: absent or include_fixed_rings false is byte-identical to the v13 baseline (no extra RNG draws -- ring accounting is deterministic). Naval and uncatalogued platforms unchanged: the flag is inert while the cap itself is inactive.
voyage_mode_note: Declared replay, verbatim from covid_theta_screen_v13_stage2: index onset_day -1.0, departure_day 5.0, dwell_weighted sanitary visits, imports 1, infection_age_days 6.8 (declared value, measured null axis under a declared onset_day, carried for cell-key bookkeeping), 20 matched seeds at base 20200205, full 32-day voyage (768 epochs).
thetas_note: Theta 1e9 anchor (QUAR-ATTR-V2 re-measurement, never a candidate) plus the five THETA-SCREEN-V13 admissible interior points verbatim. The v13 clause failed identically at all five; the assay asks whether ring-first budgeting changes the failure's class, not whether a Theta outside this set would pass.
seeds_note: The same 20 matched seeds at the same base as v10/v11/rebase_01/v13 stage 2 -- every replay cell pairs seed-for-seed with the v13 stage-2 rows at the same Theta.

arms.note: v13 measured baseline: cap active, fixed rings outside the budget -- seed-for-seed pairing against the v13 stage-2 surface.

RING-CAP-V1 arm: the shedder's susceptible cabin-mate contacts (any co-presence share) and same-table partners (dealt entry this epoch, or fixed dining party while the shedder stands on a Meal token) consume the per-epoch budget before the pooled cohort draws. Adjacent-table deals stay in the pooled reach -- venue structure, not a pre-committed ring.

cells_note: 6 points x 2 arms x 20 seeds = 240 declared-replay cells (~30 min each). Companion design covid_ring_cap_v1_fleet runs the coarse generic-voyage fleet-shape response at the five admissible Thetas, 50 seeds per row, same arms.

admissibility.note: FROZEN before any cell exists. The conditional_trajectory_clause and index_geometry audit invariant are carried verbatim from covid_theta_screen_v13_stage2; the verdict grammar is an assay's, not a screen's.

conditional_trajectory_clause.criterion: Verbatim from v13 stage 2 (v11 lineage): among takeoff seeds (recorded_onsets >= 10), the q05-q95 interval of recorded_onsets contains 197 AND median before_share within 0.10 of 0.173; scored only when >= 5 takeoff seeds.
conditional_trajectory_clause.note: Scored per (theta, arm) row. The deliverable beside it: takeoff-seed count, fraction of takeoff seeds with recorded_onsets in [98.5, 394], median and q05-q95 before_share, and the full per-seed vectors -- reported per arm so the rings-first row pairs directly against the cap_on row and the v13 row at the same Theta.

index_geometry.criterion: AUDIT INVARIANT verbatim: index_onset_day == -1.0 and index_shedding_at_day0 true in 100% of every cell's seeds; deviation invalidates the cell.
index_geometry.reads: the seeded host's own onset and shedding record

admissibility.verdict_grammar: Assay verdict, frozen: (a) the clause outcome class per (theta, arm) -- PASS/FAIL/insufficient-mass; (b) the magnitude class of any residual gap vs the v13 ~9-10x read; (c) whether ring-first budgeting changes the before_share direction. A PASS under rings_first at an admissible Theta is a mechanism finding that triggers a re-screen design, not an admission on this design; identical failures are a mechanism-ruled-out measurement, not a null result.

diagnostics.fleet_shape_indicator: Per v11 convention, reported never thresholded: P(attack <= 0.01), takeoff fraction, P(attack >= 0.10), attack-rate quantiles per arm -- the replay distribution under each arm read against the generic fleet block's.
diagnostics.paired_vs_v13: Each cap_on replay cell pairs seed-for-seed with the covid_theta_screen_v13_stage2 cell at the same Theta on image covid-theta-v13-edb7fc41: per-seed recorded_onsets / before_share deltas reported as an engine-drift check between the two images.
diagnostics.ring_spend_readout: Per row: the shedder-epoch mean fixed-ring spend (cabin-mate + same-table contacts counted) as a share of the drawn budget -- the mechanism's dose-free reach displaced, reported so a null clause move can be read against how much budget the rings actually consumed.

execution.platform: AWS Batch EC2 Spot, per .agents/skills/aws-batch-campaign/SKILL.md, via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh with DESIGN=covid_ring_cap_v1. Image built from a main containing the RING-CAP-V1 flag and all four covid_ring_cap_v1* / covid_susc_pool_v1* design files; job-definition revision and image digest pinned per campaign-preflight step 3, never a bare tag.
execution.canary: Theta 1e9 anchor row on both arms (cell order is point x arm x seed: cap_on anchor = indices 0-19, rings_first anchor = 20-39) -- proves the flag lands (spec dump shows include_fixed_rings true on arm 1 only), the audit invariant holds, and the rows are non-degenerate: INDEX_OFFSET 0, ARRAY_SIZE 40 covers both. On a clean read the remaining rows proceed per the campaign gate.
execution.report_immediately_if: any cell's audit invariant fails; every rings_first row reports insufficient takeoff mass; the clause passes only at a boundary endpoint; the clause failure changes sign or magnitude class vs the v13 read; ring-spend readout shows zero contacts consumed on any arm row (the flag did not reach the engine); or child failure rate exceeds 5%.
